why_this_seam: The existing workflow already passes classification context into Hisoka before generation and already has a bounded behavioral-strategy reader. This makes one explicit treatment-only branch measurable without changing Chrollo persona classification, Don retrieval, verification, authorization, HITL, serving, or commit semantics.
treatment_effect: LayaDecisionPolicy writes selected_response_strategy and selected_workflow_branch into a provenance-bearing classification decision; Hisoka consumes only that context to select strategy guidance.
baseline_effect: When Laya is disabled or unavailable, no Laya decision is attached and the pre-existing Hisoka context is unchanged.
